title: LLMs are Biased Teachers: Evaluating LLM Bias in Personalized Education

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the complexity level of pre-written educational explanations assigned to students by the model, and measuring the linguistic complexity (reading grade level) of generated explanations based on racial and ethnic student profiles.
Comparing the assigned difficulty level of educational texts and the readability score of generated explanations across student profiles with varying sex, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Measuring differences in the assigned educational difficulty level and the generated text readability for student profiles explicitly described as physically disabled, able-bodied, neurodivergent, or neurotypical.

Analyzing the assigned explanation complexity and the generated reading grade level of educational content across diverse religious student profiles (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, Atheist, Agnostic).
Assessing how the model assigns explanation difficulty levels and generates educational text complexity for low-income, middle-income, and high-income student profiles.
Evaluating the assigned educational difficulty and the linguistic complexity of generated text for student profiles identified as international, immigrant, or refugee.
